email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 56-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoGluca (dose: 5mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-01.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter673@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
